verdict.rationale: Caveman's own site claims automations that run by hand, on a schedule or on a GitHub event, and says working chats continue on a Cloud computer after the lid closes, which together cover background autonomous runs; it also says its agent proceeds on its own when you don't answer. The evidence is only one-line marketing claims, and the community discussion concerns the compression skill rather than automations. missing for 10: in-depth docs on configuring automations (schedule syntax, trigger options, run history, failure handling), independent or hands-on corroboration of background automation runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
